geometry.note: This is the surface building footprint, not a survey of the underground collision point. Its centroid also anchors the Tevatron ring's derived centre (see geometry:fermilab-tevatron-ring checks). The existing site record site:fermilab-d0-collision-hall still carries a coarse 3 km campus point; this OSM position is a strictly better anchor and is flagged as a site coordinate correction in the geometry worklog. This is also the first sourced coordinate found this session for the D0 hall at all -- the OSM Overpass probes the integrator ran earlier this session did not surface it (only CDF Hall); it was found by a dedicated name search for 'D0' within the campus bounding box.

method: OpenStreetMap way 51755107 'D0 Assembly building' footprint, traced verbatim (way 51755108 'D0 Outback', a small adjacent structure, was also fetched but not included in this footprint).
name: D0 Assembly Building (Tevatron D0)
